title: Pentax hotplug leaks allocations and a USB reference when registry is full
summary: The plug callback allocates device/private data and acquires a libusb reference before searching the ten-slot registry, then loses their ownership if no slot exists. Reserve a slot before allocation or clean up all acquired resources on the full-registry path; fake repeated over-capacity hotplug should retain allocations/reference counts. Existing bulb timing and PTP decoder records stay separate. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
